Hymn 75: In Hymns of Praise
Time Signature: 4/4

This is hymn number 75 titled "In Hymns of Praise" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Evan Stephens and the lyrics were written by Charles Denney Jr..
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
